Welcome to University College Birmingham’s Official YouTube Channel! 🎓✨

Located in the heart of Birmingham – one of the UK’s biggest, youngest, and most vibrant cities – we’re a university where students thrive, make lifelong connections, and expand their horizons. With £200 million invested in our campuses, we offer cutting-edge facilities and industry-led courses designed to launch successful careers.

Our teaching staff are industry experts, and we’re proud of our award-winning student support, including a £5,000 Cost of Living Allowance for full-time UK undergraduates starting in September 2025. Plus, we were recognised at the Whatuni Student Choice Awards 2024 for having the best postgraduate and international provision in the region.

🎥 Subscribe for a glimpse into student life, course insights, campus tours, success stories, and more.
